inherited.acceptance: complete authenticated custody and executed checks, independent of favorable counts; preserve original two static/seven online bounds

agreement.estimand: mean within-qid observed A1/A2 agreement fraction
agreement.missing: omit unobserved pairs; report observed qid and sibling support
agreement.unit: paired whole qid with all siblings

inherited.empty_slice_rule: unavailable with numerator/denominator/counts; never a win
inherited.interval_scope: descriptive conditional on original fit/guard/retention; no independent generalization

online.future_unit: paired whole stream preserving order, siblings and membership
online.membership: one reference-adaptive sealed mask shared by every arm, never arm-specific subsets
online.retention_unit: paired whole stream conditional on fixed TEST100; repeated retention never new qids

online_bounds: frozen_spline minus adaptive_spline future Brier lower>0
bias_only_spline minus adaptive_spline future Brier lower>0
adaptive_linear minus adaptive_spline future Brier lower>0
donor_label_spline minus adaptive_spline future Brier lower>0
temperature_only_spline minus adaptive_spline future Brier lower>0

resolution.best_case_two_sided_sign_test: 6/n at alpha0.05: six concordant nonzero qid changes have p=2^(1-6)=0.03125; not guaranteed power

inherited.scope: exposed_development; no training selection, model selection or promotion
static_bounds: combined Brier improvement lower>0 vs probability_length
combined Brier improvement lower>0 vs combined_donor
inherited.target: A1:0 correct,1 error; A2:-1/null missing, never imputed or consensus

scale_ranking.counts: error and correct sibling counts; independent support in qids
scale_ranking.selection: none; descriptive only, no new acceptance bound
scale_ranking.timing: before and after each update; rejected updates retain unchanged state
scale_ranking.unit: fixed TEST100 qids/all siblings, every arm, every stream/released-group update
